title.en: noor festival of lights at souk al seef.
title.tr: souk al seef'te noor ışık festivali.

line.en: the noor festival of lights at souk al seef runs 18:00 to 23:00 and is free. the creek-side souk is the place to walk after dark; check the programme before you go, it can still change.
line.de: das noor-lichterfest im souk al seef läuft von 18:00 bis 23:00 und ist frei. der souk am creek ist nach dem dunkel werden der ort zum schlendern; das programm vorher prüfen, es kann sich noch ändern.
line.tr: souk al seef'teki noor ışık festivali 18:00 ile 23:00 arası sürer ve ücretsizdir. creek kenarındaki çarşı karanlıktan sonra gezilecek yer; program değişebileceği için gitmeden önce kontrol et.

sparks.why: Noor Festival of Lights at Souk Al Seef, sat 7.11 18:00 to 23:00, free, per the Visit Dubai events calendar (visitdubai.com, noor-festival-of-lights-2026); the venue is also named by Gulf News.
